data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 510 reported a surplus of GBP 7.2 million in its 2018 calendar year technical result, stemming from the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years. This indicates a release of reserves. The Underwriter's report also notes a GBP 54.6 million release from 'back years' due to favourable claims development on prior years, particularly impacting Property & Special Lines. Reserve improvements from earlier years, including the 2001 World Trade Centre attacks, contributed to a positive result for the Reinsurance division.
